# Size breaches this project accepts for good, each under one of the
# exceptions in .claude/rules/code-size.md, with the reason. One per line:
#   path|construct|name|reason
# construct is file, line_length, function, ccn or params; name is the
# function's name, "-" for the file rows, or "*" for every name in that file.
# The reason may hold "|"; a name that holds one needs "*".

# Test batteries of many small cases (exception 3: file limit only). Their long
# lines are case rows, and the long functions are one table of cases each.
engine/test/bind.test.js|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
engine/test/bind.test.js|function|(anonymous)|test battery: the push guard's table of command cases (exception 3)
engine/test/gate.test.js|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
engine/test/golden.test.js|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
engine/test/keep.test.js|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
engine/test/profiles.test.js|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
engine/test/render.test.js|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
tools/test_review_gate.py|line_length|-|test battery: case rows (exception 3)
tools/test_review_gate.py|function|test_the_last_glyph_line_decides_and_a_glyphless_blocking_blocks|test battery: one table of verdict cases (exception 3)
